description: This file implements a storage service class for managing robot files and logs using MinIO object storage, including methods for uploading, retrieving, deleting files, and generating presigned URLs.

classes.name: StorageService
classes.description: A service class for interacting with MinIO storage, handling file uploads, retrievals, deletions, and URL generation.

classes.name: _StorageServiceProxy
classes.description: A proxy class for backward compatibility, forwarding attribute access to the singleton StorageService instance.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the MinIO client with credentials from settings and ensures the storage bucket exists.

methods.name: _ensure_bucket_exists
methods.description: Checks if the storage bucket exists; creates it if it does not.

methods.name: upload_file
methods.description: Uploads a file to MinIO storage, returning the object name.

methods.name: get_file
methods.description: Retrieves a file from MinIO storage as bytes, or returns None if not found.

methods.name: delete_file
methods.description: Deletes a specified file from MinIO storage, returning success status.

methods.name: get_presigned_url
methods.description: Generates a presigned URL for accessing a file, with optional expiry.
